name: Povanaria
description: Povanaria was a world located in the Povanaria system. It was situated in the Loop Worlds area of the Gordian Reach sector within the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The hyperlane known as the Junction-Tierell Loop connected it to the Bronsoon and Durgen's Star systems. Povanaria was a windswept world of low grasses and moss, and it was the homeworld of the Povanarian species, members of which had already traveled offworld centuries prior to 43 ABY.
